overview.name: Aagaman Campus
overview.address: Duhabi-3, Sunsari, Koshi Province, opposite Sunsari Samudayak Hospital
overview.description: Private campus established in 2070 BS. It runs National Examination Board plus-two programs and Tribhuvan University bachelor programs in management, education, hotel management, and general science.

overview.name: Adarsha College
overview.description: Sister institution of Vishwa Adarsha Academy in Itahari. Edusanjal lists it as affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University. The college site describes work in management, law, IT, humanities, and social sciences.
overview.mission: To foster innovative pedagogies and research in diverse fields of knowledge including management, law, IT, humanities and social sciences.
overview.vision: To contribute to social development through quality education, research and innovation in multidisciplinary fields.

overview.name: Alpine College
overview.description: Private college established in 2067 BS on College Road, Dharan, offering a Tribhuvan University Bachelor of Business Studies program.

overview.name: B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences
overview.university: B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences
overview.address: Dharan Sub-Metropolitan City, Koshi Province, Nepal
overview.description: Health-sciences institute and teaching hospital in Dharan. Public pages describe undergraduate pathways in MBBS, BDS, BSc Nursing, and allied health, plus postgraduate and fellowship training.

updates.title: Result of Written Examination of Senior Resident/Lecturer
updates.summary: Notice listed on the BPKIHS homepage.

updates.title: Notice of Written Examination for Senior Resident/Lecturer
updates.summary: Notice listed on the BPKIHS homepage.

updates.title: Result of Staff Nurse
updates.summary: Notice listed on the BPKIHS homepage.

updates.title: Notice regarding Students Admission at B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences, Dharan
updates.summary: Admission notice listed on the BPKIHS homepage.

updates.title: Vacancy Notice of Medical-Dental Officer
updates.summary: Vacancy notice listed on the BPKIHS homepage.

overview.name: TNK Balaha Multiple Campus
overview.description: Community campus in Inaruwa listed by Edusanjal under Tribhuvan University. A public course page describes a four-year BBS program.

overview.name: Bharabi Science College
overview.address: Itahari, Sunsari; previously located in Dharan
overview.description: Private science campus established in 2062 BS. It shifted from Dharan to Itahari and offers Tribhuvan University BSc programs, including physics and microbiology.

overview.name: Bhadgaun Sinuwari Multiple Campus
overview.description: Community campus established in 2067 BS at Jhumka, Ramdhuni. It is affiliated to Tribhuvan University for BBS and B.Ed.

overview.name: Bijayapur Technical Institute
overview.description: Private CTEVT technical institute established in 2071 BS. It offers PCL General Medicine, Diploma in Pharmacy, and Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology.

overview.name: Birendra Memorial College
overview.description: Private Tribhuvan University college in Dharan, established in 2060 BS. Public pages list BSc CSIT, BSc Microbiology, BBS, and MBS.

overview.name: Central Campus of Technology
overview.description: Constituent campus of Tribhuvan University in Hattisar, Dharan. It developed from the Institute of Applied Science and Technology established in Dharan in 1972 and offers science, food technology, nutrition, and IT programs.

updates.title: B.Sc. Nutrition and Dietetics Entrance - 2082 Notice
updates.summary: Entrance notice published on the Central Campus of Technology notices page.

overview.name: College of Nursing, B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences
overview.university: B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences
overview.description: Nursing college unit of B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences in Dharan. The institute homepage lists BSc Nursing among undergraduate programs.

overview.name: Depot Adarsha Multiple Campus
overview.description: Private campus established in 2071 BS at Ghopa Camp, Dharan, near BPKIHS. It offers a four-year Tribhuvan University BBS program.

overview.name: Dharan City College
overview.description: Tribhuvan University-affiliated college in Dharan, described in a public college list as founded in 2009 by teachers of Dharan. Published programs include BA, BBS, and B.Ed.

overview.name: Dharan College of Management
overview.description: Purbanchal University management college established in 2058 BS at Dharan-1. Public pages state that it runs BBA and MBA programs.
overview.vision: Enhancing the capacity of individuals and institutions to contribute to the nation’s development.

overview.name: Dharan Mega College
overview.description: Listed as a college in Dharan-12 on the Wikipedia list of educational institutions in Dharan. No public program, affiliation, or contact page was confirmed in this search.

overview.name: Dharan Model College
overview.description: Higher-education branch of Dharan Model Academy, established in 2066 BS. It runs Tribhuvan University bachelor programs in management, education, humanities, and social work.

overview.name: Dharan Multiple Campus
overview.description: Private higher-education institution established in 2068 BS. A public directory states it is affiliated with Tribhuvan University for bachelor programs including B.Tech Food Technology.

overview.name: Edutek College
overview.address: Itahari-9, Biratnagar line (Gaisar Road), opposite Chintan Chautari, Sunsari
overview.description: College in Itahari publicly advertising plus-two streams and bachelor programs. Social listings mark some bachelor programs with an asterisk. A university affiliation was not confirmed on an official academic page in this search.

updates.title: Regular classes resume
updates.summary: Public listing states that regular classes resume from the next day according to the published routine.

overview.name: Godawari College
overview.description: Private college established in 2049 BS under Peace Foundation, which also operates Sushma Koirala Memorial Engineering College and Sushma Secondary School. Edusanjal lists TU BBS and BSc CSIT, and a KU BSW program commencing in 2025.

overview.name: Green Peace Lincoln College
overview.address: People’s Marga, ISMT Chowk, Itahari-10, Sunsari; also published as Dipendra Chowk, Itahari
overview.description: Private college established in 2071 BS, affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia. Its site lists BIT, BBA, and MBA.
overview.mission: To establish an ideal education center that offers a learning environment of global-standard from pre- to master’s level in various programs.
overview.vision: To be an acclaimed and respected academic institution committed towards innovation, entrepreneurship, ethics and competence based learning so as to develop integrated personality of the students.

overview.name: Harinagara Multiple College
overview.description: Community campus established in 2079 BS and affiliated with Purbanchal University. It runs four-year B.Ed. and BBS programs, with 60 seats published for each.

overview.name: Ithari Global College
overview.description: Itahari college affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University. Edusanjal states that it offers BCA and BSc CSIT.

overview.name: Itahari Namuna College
overview.description: Private college established in 2070 BS in Itahari. Edusanjal lists TU programs in BHM, BCA, BSW, BBS, and BA. The college website also advertises BBM.

overview.name: Janata Multiple Campus
overview.description: Community campus established on 30 Ashad 2045 BS to provide university education in Itahari at moderate fees. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and was QAA-accredited by UGC Nepal on 30 November 2018.

updates.title: UGC QAA accreditation
updates.summary: UGC Nepal lists Janata Multiple Campus, Sunsari, as accredited on 30 November 2018, with the listed validity until 29 November 2023.

overview.name: Jibika College of Agricultural Sciences
overview.address: Ramdhuni, Sunsari; also listed as Itahari, Sunsari
overview.description: Cooperative-run college affiliated to Agriculture and Forestry University, Rampur. Public pages state that it runs a four-year B.Sc. Agriculture program.

overview.name: Kasturi College
overview.description: Itahari college in the Kasturi group. Public pages state that it offers Purbanchal University BBA and BIT, and a course page lists 96 BBA seats.

overview.name: Kasturi College of Management
overview.description: Management wing of the Kasturi group at B.P. Chowk, Itahari. Public pages state that it offers Tribhuvan University BBS and MBS.

overview.name: Kaushiki Campus
overview.description: Community campus established in 2060 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. It focuses on teacher education, including four-year and one-year B.Ed. routes.
overview.mission: To expand access to quality, TU-standard teacher education for students in Dharan and surrounding districts through affordable programs and need-sensitive support.
overview.vision: To be a trusted community campus in Koshi Province for teacher preparation, known for affordability, academic integrity, and student support.

overview.name: Koshi Saint James College
overview.description: Private college founded in 2064 BS by academic professionals and managed by Koshi Academy. Its website states that it runs Tribhuvan University BBS and BCA programs in downtown Itahari.

overview.name: Mahendra Multiple Campus, Dharan
overview.description: Constituent campus of Tribhuvan University, established in 2012 BS. Edusanjal lists bachelor and master programs in humanities, law, management, and education. Another directory also lists additional management and arts programs.

overview.name: Makalu Technical College
overview.description: Private CTEVT nursing college in Inaruwa, recognized by the Nepal Nursing Council. Public pages state that it offers three-year PCL Nursing with 40 seats.

updates.title: PCL Nursing Admission Open for Vacant Seats
updates.summary: College directory notice of vacant-seat admission for PCL Nursing.

overview.name: Nara Bahadur Karmacharya Memorial Polytechnic Institute
overview.description: Itahari technical institute affiliated with CTEVT. A national diploma-pharmacy listing names Nara Bahadur Karmacharya Polytechnic Institute, Itahari, among Koshi Province diploma pharmacy colleges.

overview.name: National Academy of Applied Science and Technology
overview.description: Described as a sister organization of Dharan Multiple Campus, operating since 1999. A public directory states that it runs National Examination Board plus-two programs and a CTEVT food or dairy development diploma.

overview.name: National College of Integrated Studies
overview.description: Private college in Itahari, established in 2024 and affiliated with Rajarshi Janak University. Edusanjal states that it offers BBA and MBA.

overview.name: National Multiple College
overview.description: Private college established in 2062 BS and affiliated with Purbanchal University. Public pages list Bachelor of Business Studies and Bachelor of Education.

overview.name: Nilgiri College
overview.description: Private food-technology college founded in 2069 BS by food-technology professionals. It offers a four-year Tribhuvan University B.Tech in Food Technology.

overview.name: Peoples Multiple Health Institute
overview.description: Private health institute established in 2060 BS, affiliated to CTEVT and recognized by the Nepal Nursing Council. It offers PCL Nursing with 40 seats.
overview.mission: By providing nursing education in a good environment and educational facilities to produce competent nursing manpower.
overview.vision: To produce capable nursing manpower for the nation.

overview.name: Pindeshwar Vidyapeeth
overview.description: Sanskrit campus in the premises of Pindeshwar Temple. Edusanjal states that it runs as a branch of Nepal Sanskrit University and offers Prak Shastri, Shastri, and Acharya. Another directory lists Uttarmadhyama and Acharya.

updates.title: Pindeshwor Vidyapeeth releases two issues of Shodh Sudha and holds research presentations
updates.summary: Directory notice about journal issues and research presentations.

overview.name: Purwanchal Campus, Institute of Engineering
overview.description: Constituent engineering campus of Tribhuvan University Institute of Engineering, formerly Eastern Region Campus. The campus site states it was established in Poush 2034 BS under an Asian Development Bank loan agreement and lists bachelor programs in civil, agricultural, mechanical, electrical, computer, and electronics and communication engineering.

courses.name: Bachelor in Electronics and Communication Engineering

overview.name: Rastriya Janasahayog College
overview.address: Itahari-20, Tarahara, Sunsari; also listed as Hansposa, Itahari
overview.description: Community college established in 2066 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. A public profile lists BBS and B.Ed.

overview.name: Sacred Heart College
overview.description: College in Itahari-7 established in 2025 and affiliated with Purbanchal University for BBA. Edusanjal classifies the institution as public.

overview.name: Sagarmatha College
overview.address: Mahananda Marga, Dharan, Sunsari; also indexed as Itahari, Sunsari
overview.description: Tribhuvan University college listed by Edusanjal at Mahananda Marga, Dharan/Itahari. A public course page describes a four-year BBS program and places the campus in Dharan-3.

overview.name: Saradha Balika Namuna Multiple Campus
overview.description: Dharan campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Edusanjal states that it offers BBS and classifies it as a public institution.

overview.name: Saptakoshi Multiple Campus
overview.description: Community campus established in 2067 BS. It received Tribhuvan University affiliation for BBS in 2067 BS and for the Faculty of Education in 2069 BS.

overview.name: Sunsari Multiple Campus
overview.description: Community campus established in 2037 BS under local educationists, including parliamentarian Shyam Prasad Gupta. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and runs management, education, and humanities programs from bachelor to master level, alongside plus-two.

overview.name: Sunsari Technical College
overview.description: Technical college established in 2052 BS, formerly Sunsari Technical School. It is affiliated with Tribhuvan University and CTEVT and is described as recognized by Nepal Pharmacy Council, Nepal Health Professional Council, and Nepal Nursing Council.
overview.vision: To be a world-class academic enterprise, striving for academic and professional excellence in technical education, research and development and service to the industry and society of the nation.

overview.name: Sushma Koirala Memorial Engineering College
overview.description: Private CTEVT engineering college established in 2056 BS. Edusanjal states that it runs three-year diplomas in civil and computer engineering, with 48 seats in each. It is part of the same institutional group as Godawari College.

overview.name: United National College
overview.description: Private college in Dharan established in 2071 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. Public pages list BBS and BHM.

overview.name: Vijayapur College
overview.description: Private college established in 2043 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. A public profile states that it offers Bachelor of Business Studies.

overview.name: Vishwa Adarsha College
overview.description: Private college in Itahari established in 2055 BS and affiliated with Tribhuvan University. A public profile lists BCA, BBS, and MBS.
